dialogue.text: Bunzo the little rabbit loved to play in the sunny park.

dialogue.speaker: bunzo
dialogue.text: What a beautiful day! I will hop and play!
But Bunzo had heard stories about a tall, long-legged monster in the forest.

dialogue.speaker: bunzo
dialogue.text: I am a little scared, but I am brave too!
One day, Bunzo decided to go to the forest to see for himself.

dialogue.speaker: bunzo
dialogue.text: Here I go! Into the forest!
Bunzo hopped along the forest path, looking around carefully.

dialogue.speaker: bunzo
dialogue.text: The forest is big and quiet. I hope I don't get lost.
Suddenly, a tall figure with very long legs stepped out from behind a tree.

dialogue.speaker: mommy_long_legs
dialogue.text: Hello, little rabbit. Why do you look so worried?

dialogue.speaker: bunzo
dialogue.text: Oh! You are so tall! Are you the monster?

dialogue.speaker: mommy_long_legs
dialogue.text: I am Mommy Long Legs. I am not scary. I am a friend.
Mommy Long Legs and Bunzo walked to a beautiful flower meadow.

dialogue.speaker: bunzo
dialogue.text: Wow! So many flowers! I will pick this red one for you!
Bunzo picked the flower and held it out to Mommy Long Legs.

dialogue.speaker: mommy_long_legs
dialogue.text: Oh, it's lovely! But you should keep it, Bunzo. It's your favorite.

dialogue.speaker: bunzo
dialogue.text: No, I want you to have it. Friends share!

dialogue.speaker: mommy_long_legs
dialogue.text: Thank you, Bunzo. You are very kind.
Mommy Long Legs invited Bunzo to her garden for a snack.

dialogue.speaker: bunzo
dialogue.text: Your garden is so pretty! I love the flowers.

dialogue.speaker: mommy_long_legs
dialogue.text: Let's have some carrot tea. I picked carrots from my garden.
Mommy Long Legs brought two cups of warm carrot tea.

dialogue.speaker: bunzo
dialogue.text: This is delicious! Thank you, Mommy.

dialogue.speaker: mommy_long_legs
dialogue.text: I'm happy you came to visit, little bunny.
In the evening, they went to the clear lake to watch the sunset.

dialogue.speaker: bunzo
dialogue.text: The lake is so shiny! Let's dance!

dialogue.speaker: mommy_long_legs
dialogue.text: I love dancing with you, Bunzo!
They danced and laughed as the sun went down.

dialogue.speaker: bunzo
dialogue.text: I was scared at first, but now I have a new best friend!
And so, Bunzo learned that friends can be tall or small, and kindness is what matters.
